headline: Indian stock market closed today for Dussehra; Sensex fell 876 points in last trading session

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 21 October.

why: BSE and NSE are closed on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, due to the Dussehra holiday.
On the last trading day, Sensex crashed 876 points and Nifty dropped 1.11% as investors lost Rs 5 lakh crore.
Private banking and IT stocks led the market drop during the previous session.
Anticipation around major upcoming issues like the Jio IPO opening on October 21 is driving market focus.
whatHappening: Stock exchanges BSE, NSE, and commodity markets are closed today for Dussehra.
Trading on Indian stock markets will resume on Wednesday, October 21.
In the previous session, Sensex fell up to 1,000 points dragged by private bank and IT shares.
Jio IPO grey market premium (GMP) reached 22% ahead of its opening on October 21.
summary:
Indian stock exchanges BSE and NSE are closed today, October 20, for Dussehra.
In the last trading session, Sensex and Nifty fell over 1% led by losses in banking and IT stocks.
Trading will resume on Wednesday, October 21, as investors track upcoming market events like the Jio IPO.
